list: The official 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden. Names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them, via the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

sources.officialList: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (official names, descriptions, grades)
sources.counts: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PSN counts where PlayStation tracks one)

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum: it unlocks by itself the moment you earn the other 54 trophies, so there is nothing to do for it directly. Work through the roadmap in this guide — story first, then side content and collectibles, then the long grinds — and it will pop last. Sources: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; our own advice from the official description.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies in any order.
Check the tracker here: when it reads 54 of 55, one trophy remains.
Earn that last trophy and the platinum unlocks with it.
sources: Own advice from the official description

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end. It is the first story mission, so you cannot miss it by playing normally — just follow the on-screen objectives until the mission-complete screen. No special requirement is stated in the official description, and no location beyond the mission itself is pinned down by it. Sources: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; our own advice from the official description.
steps: Start a new game and play the opening mission Gone Fishing.
Follow the mission objectives to completion.
The trophy unlocks at the mission-complete screen.
sources: Own advice from the official description

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. Chapter trophies unlock automatically when the chapter's final mission ends, so keep playing the story in order and it will come. The official description names no specific mission, so there is no extra step to prepare for. Sources: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; our own advice from the official description.
steps: Play through the story missions of Chapter 1 in order.
Complete the chapter's final mission.
The trophy unlocks as Chapter 1 closes.
sources: Own advice from the official description

Note the missable trophy in this guide before the finale, since story choices are the one thing the descriptions suggest can be locked in. steps: Play the story through Chapters 1 to 4.
Before the finale, check the Missable page in this guide.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion in the game's stats screen. This is the second gold trophy and the real endgame: it needs the story, the side missions, the collectibles and the activities all finished, so treat it as the checklist for everything else in this guide. Check the in-game completion percentage as you go and mop up whichever category is lowest. Sources: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the trophy list; our own advice from the official description.
steps: Finish the story and every side-mission strand.
Complete the collectibles and activities tracked in this guide.
Watch the in-game completion stat until it reads 100%.
sources: Own advice from the official description

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — jumps, near-misses, drifts and other driving feats the game counts as a stunt. The count is cumulative across the whole playthrough, so it builds naturally while you drive between missions; a fast car and the open highways of Leonida are the practical way to farm the remainder. The official description does not say which stunt types count, so treat every stunt the game flashes on screen as progress and watch the PSN count. Sources: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the PSN count of 250; our own advice from the official description.
steps: Drive fast and stunt often during normal play; the count is cumulative.
Use jumps and long highway runs to rack up stunts quickly.
Check the PSN progress count until it reaches 250.
sources: Own advice from the official description

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every type of activity the game offers at least once — racing, fishing, shooting range, arcade games, bowling and the rest. The official description does not list the activity types, so the honest method is to open the activities menu and work through it type by type, ticking each off in this tracker as you try it. Nothing here needs a win, only one try each. Sources: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; our own advice from the official description.
steps: Open the in-game activities list and note every type it shows.
Try each type once — a win is not required.
When every type has been tried once, the trophy unlocks.
sources: Own advice from the official description

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges — the count PlayStation tracks for this trophy. This is the hardest silver in the set: take one weapon class at a time, learn each challenge's target pattern, and replay a challenge until gold rather than moving on with a silver. The official description pins down the target (gold in every challenge) but not the range locations, which are not stated here. Sources: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the PSN count of 42; our own advice from the official description.
steps: Visit a shooting range and open its challenge list.
Work through the 42 challenges, replaying each until gold.
Gold in all 42 unlocks the silver trophy.
sources: Own advice from the official description

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every race location. You need a win at each one, not just a finish, so learn each course's line and replay the ones you lose. The official description does not state how many locations there are, so use the in-game race list and tick locations off as you win them — the trophy pops when the last location is won. Sources: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; our own advice from the official description.
steps: Open the Top Fun Drone Race list and note every location.
Win a race at each location, replaying losses.
The trophy unlocks when every location has a win.
sources: Own advice from the official description

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race 20 times. Spread your wins across race types and locations, and keep a mental note of which events you have already won so you do not waste runs repeating one. The official description does not name the races, so the in-game race list is the checklist to follow. Sources: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the PSN count of 20; our own advice from the official description.
steps: Open the race list and pick events you have not won yet.
Win 20 different race events.
The trophy unlocks at the 20th distinct win.
sources: Own advice from the official description

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head, so the catch total decides it: fish steadily, keep your line in the water, and do not waste time reeling in small catches when a bigger one is on. The official description names Cal and the fishing challenge but no spot, so take the challenge wherever Cal offers it. Sources: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; our own advice from the official description.
steps: Find Cal's fishing challenge.
Out-fish Cal across the challenge.
The trophy unlocks when you beat him.
sources: Own advice from the official description

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game to its end. Any arcade machine counts, so pick the shortest game you find and play it through — no high score is required, only a completion. The official description names no specific game or machine, so the location is not pinned down here. Sources: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; our own advice from the official description.
steps: Find any arcade machine in Leonida.
Play one arcade game through to its end.
The trophy unlocks on completion.
sources: Own advice from the official description

Complete his final mission to unlock the trophy.

trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers appear as markers on the map as the story progresses; finish a whole strand, then move to the next stranger. Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each have a strand with its own trophy, so those five count toward the eight — find three more strangers to finish the set. steps: Watch the map for stranger markers as the story progresses.

Finish 8 strands in total to unlock the silver trophy.

trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Hunting missions give you a target and usually a region to search; track it, take the shot cleanly, and bring the hunt to its end. The official description names Bret and the unique animal but not the species or the hunting ground, so those are not pinned down here — follow Bret's instructions in the game. steps: Take Bret's hunting request.
Track and hunt the unique animal he names.
Complete the hunt to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida, so collect them as you explore and check your collection to see which sets are close to complete; finish the three easiest sets first rather than chasing one rare card. The official description does not name the sets or the card locations, so those are not pinned down here. Sources: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the PSN count of 3; our own advice from the official description.
steps: Collect cards while exploring Leonida.
Check your collection to see which sets are nearest complete.
Finish 3 full sets to unlock the silver trophy.
sources: Own advice from the official description

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations. This is a long grind — treat it as a map-completion task and work region by region, using WAiNK It at every new spot you reach rather than trying to farm it in one place. The count is cumulative and the official description does not list the locations, so progress is tracked by the PSN count. Sources: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the PSN count of 100; our own advice from the official description.
steps: Use WAiNK It at each new location you visit.
Work region by region so no area is left behind.
Reach 100 locations to unlock the silver trophy.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's small optional objectives, spread across driving, combat, exploration and activities — clear the easy ones first and let the count build as you play. The official description does not list the challenges, so use the in-game challenge list and pick off the ones nearest completion. steps: Open the in-game challenge list.
Complete the easiest challenges first.
Reach 50 completed challenges.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape. The partner must be with you for it to count, so do this during a mission or activity where your partner is present, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the stars clear. A fast car and the back roads out of the city are the practical escape. Sources: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; our own advice from the official description.
steps: Get your partner with you, then raise your wanted level to 4 stars.
Break line of sight and leave the search area.
Escape clean and the trophy unlocks when the stars clear.
sources: Own advice from the official description

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without losing your wanted level between robberies — the wanted level must stay active across all three. Plan a route with three close-together shops, rob each quickly, and keep moving; do not let the stars clear or get arrested between shops. If the wanted level drops, start the run of three again. Sources: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; our own advice from the official description.
steps: Bring your partner and pick three shops close together.
Rob the first shop and keep your wanted level active.
Rob the second and third without the stars clearing.
sources: Own advice from the official description

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Discovering means finding and driving a vehicle type you have not logged before, so variety is the method: try new cars, bikes, boats and aircraft wherever you see them instead of sticking to one favourite. The count is cumulative across the playthrough. Sources: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the PSN count of 100; our own advice from the official description.
steps: Drive a wide variety of vehicles as you explore.
Try any new vehicle type you see — cars, bikes, boats, aircraft.
Reach 100 discovered vehicles.
sources: Own advice from the official description

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Set it up where enemies group together — a mission firefight with cover and several targets — trigger Combat Focus, and chain the five takedowns before it ends. If you fall short, retry the fight rather than hunting stragglers in free roam. Sources: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; our own advice from the official description.
steps: Find a firefight with at least 5 grouped enemies.
Trigger Combat Focus.
Take down 5 enemies before it ends.
sources: Own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At VCIA, the Vice City airport, leave by an unscheduled departure — take a plane out without going through the normal scheduled route. The official description is deliberately vague, so the honest reading is: get into an aircraft at the airport and get airborne on your own terms rather than by a scripted flight. Expect airport security to object. Sources: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; our own advice from the official description.
steps: Go to VCIA airport.
Get into an aircraft.
Take off on an unscheduled departure.
sources: Own advice from the official description

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: This trophy's description is a joke, not an instruction: 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' points at the Rhino tank. The plain reading is to get into a Rhino tank and use it — the heat is the point, so expect a wanted level and a fight. No location or count is stated in the official description, so no specific base or spawn is pinned down here; a Rhino found in free roam or during a high-wanted-level rampage is the way in. Sources: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; our own advice from the official description.
steps: Find a Rhino tank in Leonida.
Get in and drive it.
The trophy unlocks from the Rhino encounter.
sources: Own advice from the official description

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected at any point. Go in quiet: move slowly, avoid cameras and staff sightlines, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails — leave, lose any attention, and try again. The official description names no specific store, so any jewelry store counts. Sources: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; our own advice from the official description.
steps: Pick a jewelry store and approach quietly.
Rob it without being seen by staff or cameras.
Leave undetected to unlock the trophy.
sources: Own advice from the official description

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Each vault is a full job — get in, crack the vault, get out before the response closes in — and only an escape counts, so plan your getaway vehicle before you go in. The count is cumulative, so the five vaults can be done across the playthrough. Sources: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the PSN count of 5; our own advice from the official description.
steps: Find a bank vault robbery and plan a getaway vehicle first.
Rob the vault and escape.
Repeat until 5 vaults are robbed and escaped.
sources: Own advice from the official description

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida — intercept one, stop it, take the cash, and get away before the police response builds. A fast getaway car parked nearby before you strike is the difference between a payout and an arrest. Sources: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; our own advice from the official description.
steps: Find an armored truck on its route.
Stop it and take the cash.
Escape to unlock the trophy.
sources: Own advice from the official description

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore every area of Leonida — the whole map, city and countryside. Areas register as you visit them, so drive and fly across the state systematically and watch the map fill in; the last unvisited corner is usually a remote beach, island or back road. The official description does not state how many areas there are, so the map itself is the checklist. Sources: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; our own advice from the official description.
steps: Travel across Leonida, city and countryside.
Visit every region until the map is fully revealed.
The trophy unlocks at the last unexplored area.
sources: Own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida. Each gang runs its own operations, so you need one hit per gang, not several hits on the same gang — vary your targets and keep a note of which gangs you have already hit. The official description does not name the gangs, so the in-game gang and operation lists are the checklist. Sources: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; our own advice from the official description.

Rob one operation for each gang.
The trophy unlocks when every gang has been hit once.
sources: Own advice from the official description

Order a cocktail at a beachfront bar.
Enjoy the view to unlock the trophy.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: THE ONE MISSABLE TROPHY in this list. The description — 'Choices made (for better or worse)' — is the only one in the official list that turns on a story choice rather than a task you can repeat later. Choices in the story lock in once made, so the safe play is to keep a manual save before every major story decision, make the choice, and check whether the trophy pops; if it does not, reload the save and try the other option. Do this before the final mission — after the story ends there may be no choice left to make. No specific decision is named in the official description, so no mission is pinned down here. Sources: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; our own reading of the official description, which is the only one that implies a one-way choice.

Make the choice and check whether the trophy pops.
If it does not, reload the save and choose the other way — before the final mission.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second attempt at something you first failed — 'second time's the charm'. The plain reading is that a retry matters: fail an activity or challenge once, then pass it on the immediate second try. No specific activity is named in the official description, so no location is pinned down here; play normally, and when you fail something, retry it at once. Sources: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; our own advice from the official description.

Retry it immediately.
Pass on the second attempt to unlock the trophy.

trophies.guide: Witness something strange — the description is a reaction, not an instruction. Leonida hides odd events and encounters off the beaten path, so explore unusual places, especially at night, and let the strange event play out in front of you. No place, time or event is named in the official description, so none is pinned down here. trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a melee drive-by. Drive slowly past a pedestrian, swing a melee weapon from the vehicle, and connect. Pick a quiet street so you can line the pass up without traffic in the way, and keep your speed low enough to aim. Sources: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; our own advice from the official description.

Drive slowly past a pedestrian.
Hit them with a melee attack from the moving vehicle.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists, and contacts clean them for a cut — keep laundering every bill you earn instead of spending dirty money, and the total builds across the playthrough. The PSN count tracks the $250,000 target. trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative and counts every shop purchase, so buy weapons, clothes, vehicles and upgrades as you play and the number climbs on its own — save this for late in the playthrough, when money is plentiful, and top it up with a big purchase. The PSN count tracks the $100,000 target. trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase every garage property in Leonida. Garages are bought with in-game money, so save this for late in the playthrough when you can afford them all, and buy each one as you find it for sale. The official description does not state how many garages there are, so the property list in the game is the checklist. Sources: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; our own advice from the official description.

Own every garage to unlock the trophy.
